description: Provenance figure: PTHR23148 membership vs actual domain content, Pfam HUP clan placement, Foldseek hit-class composition, orthologue feature table and GO decision table
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mp, pandas as pd, numpy as np, os, re, json
OUT=os.getcwd()
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15.5,11.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.05,1.0,1.0],hspace=0.5,wspace=0.22)

# A: PTHR23148 membership and what each member actually contains
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:]); ax.axis('off')
mem=[("Q8IYB3","Homo sapiens","SRRM1",904,"PWI (27-126)","yes"),
     ("Q52KI8","Mus musculus","SRRM1",946,"PWI","yes"),
     ("Q5ZMJ9","Gallus gallus","SRRM1",888,"PWI","yes"),
     ("Q5R5Q2","Pongo abelii","SRRM1",917,"PWI","yes"),
     ("Q9USH5","S. pombe","PWI dom. protein C825.05c",301,"PWI (SM00311, SSF101233)","yes"),
     ("Q03361","S. cerevisiae","JIP4",876,"PF29926 HUP-clan + PF29925","NO")]
t=ax.table(cellText=[[a,o,n,str(l),d,p] for a,o,n,l,d,p in mem],
           colLabels=["UniProt","organism","protein","aa","structural domain content","PWI?"],loc='center',cellLoc='left')
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(8.5); t.scale(1,1.5)
for j in range(6): t[0,j].set_facecolor('#dfe6ec')
for j in range(6): t[6,j].set_facecolor('#fdece9')
ax.set_title('A  All six reviewed members of PANTHER PTHR23148 ("serine/arginine repetitive matrix") carry a PWI domain, except yeast JIP4',
             fontsize=10.5,loc='left')

# B: HUP clan placement
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0]); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('B  Pfam itself places the JIP4 domain in the HUP clan,\n    the clan that contains the universal stress proteins',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.add_patch(mp.FancyBboxPatch((0.03,0.08),0.94,0.72,boxstyle="round,pad=0.02",fc='#eef3f7',ec='#4a6b8a'))
ax.text(0.5,0.73,'Pfam clan CL0039 "HUP"  (42 families)',ha='center',fontsize=10,weight='bold')
ax.text(0.5,0.645,'HIGH-signature / class I aaRS  |  UspA superfamily  |  PP-loop ATPase',ha='center',fontsize=8.2,style='italic')
for x,lab,c in [(0.27,'PF00582\nUniversal stress\nprotein family','#16a085'),(0.72,'PF29926\nJIP4 N-terminal\ndomain','#c0392b')]:
    ax.add_patch(mp.FancyBboxPatch((x-0.19,0.22),0.38,0.33,boxstyle="round,pad=0.015",fc='white',ec=c,lw=2))
    ax.text(x,0.385,lab,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,color=c)
ax.annotate('',xy=(0.53,0.385),xytext=(0.47,0.385),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->',color='#555'))
ax.text(0.5,0.145,'Foldseek narrows PF29926 within the clan to the UspA branch\n(1MJH E=5e-5, prob 1.0, 1.55 $\\AA$ core RMSD over 79 C$\\alpha$)',ha='center',fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_ylim(0,1)

# C: hit class composition
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
df=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"foldseek_JIP4_183_487_hits.csv")); df=df[~df.target.str.contains("Q03361")]
def cls(n):
    n=n.lower()
    if re.search(r"usp|universal stress|adenine nucleotide alpha hydrolase|imp2",n): return "USP / UspA branch"
    if re.search(r"synthetase|aminoacyl|trna ligase",n): return "class I aaRS branch"
    if re.search(r"pp-loop|sulfurtransferase|mnma|tils",n): return "PP-loop ATPase branch"
    if re.search(r"jip4|ydr475|yor019|ygr237",n): return "JIP4 orthologue group"
    return "other / unlabelled"
dbs=['pdb100','afdb-swissprot','afdb-proteome']; order=["USP / UspA branch","JIP4 orthologue group","class I aaRS branch","PP-loop ATPase branch","other / unlabelled"]
cols=dict(zip(order,['#16a085','#2e86de','#e67e22','#8e44ad','#b0b7bd']))
bottom=np.zeros(len(dbs))
for k in order:
    v=[]
    for d in dbs:
        s=df[(df.db==d)&(df['eval']<1e-3)]
        v.append(100*(s.target.map(cls)==k).sum()/max(len(s),1))
    ax.bar(dbs,v,bottom=bottom,label=k,color=cols[k]); bottom+=np.array(v)
ax.set_ylabel('% of Foldseek hits with E < 1e-3'); ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc='lower right')
ax.set_title('C  Within the HUP clan the hits are the UspA branch,\n    not class I aaRS or PP-loop ATPase',fontsize=10,loc='left')
for i,d in enumerate(dbs):
    ax.text(i,102,f"n={len(df[(df.db==d)&(df['eval']<1e-3)])}",ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylim(0,112)

# D: orthologue feature table
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0]); ax.axis('off')
rows=[["S. cerevisiae JIP4 (Q03361)","PF29926 (HUP clan)","PTHR23148 SRRM","absent","none"],
      ["S. cerevisiae YOR019W (Q99248)","PF29926 (HUP clan)","PTHR47815 UspA","SSF52402 239-366","none"],
      ["S. cerevisiae YGR237C (P50089)","PF29926 (HUP clan)","none","absent","none"],
      ["S. pombe C167.05 (P87132)","PF00582 UspA","PTHR46100 Imp2'","SSF52402 437-572","PRINTS UNVRSLSTRESS"]]
t=ax.table(cellText=rows,colLabels=["protein","Pfam domain","PANTHER family","SCOP superfamily","other USP evidence"],loc='center',cellLoc='left')
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(7.6); t.scale(1,1.55)
for j in range(5): t[0,j].set_facecolor('#dfe6ec')
for j in range(5): t[1,j].set_facecolor('#fdece9')
ax.set_title('D  The same structural region is called UspA in three relatives\n    and "SRRM" only in JIP4',fontsize=10,loc='left')

# E: GO decision table
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1]); ax.axis('off')
rows=[["GO:0005681 spliceosomal complex","CC","IBA","PTHR23148","REMOVE (lead)"],
      ["GO:0048024 reg. of mRNA splicing","BP","IBA","PTHR23148","REMOVE (lead)"],
      ["GO:0003674 molecular_function","MF","ND","SGD","keep, or see note"],
      ["GO:0005524 ATP binding","MF","-","not annotated","do NOT add"],
      ["USP-fold domain, 184-490","MF","-","this analysis","no MF term supported"]]
t=ax.table(cellText=rows,colLabels=["current / candidate term","aspect","ev","source","lead action"],loc='center',cellLoc='left')
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(7.8); t.scale(1,1.55)
for j in range(5): t[0,j].set_facecolor('#dfe6ec')
for i in (1,2):
    for j in range(5): t[i,j].set_facecolor('#fdece9')
ax.set_title('E  GO consequence: both non-ND annotations on JIP4 ride on\n    the PTHR23148 family call that the structure contradicts',fontsize=10,loc='left')
plt.show()
